interpretation: All downloadable rows are synthetic. Two cases bootstrap aggregate Jigjiga count frequencies and assign artificial scores; none reproduce historical OOF predictions.

cases.title: Four-site worked example
cases.description: A fixed, hand-checkable example: model area 0.600, ideal area 0.625, normalized lift 0.800.
cases.generator: Fixed hand-constructed illustration, not empirical data. The seed does not change this case.

cases.title: Perfect retrospective order
cases.description: Scores equal the observed outcomes. This is an oracle reference, not a deployable prediction model.
cases.generator: Mulberry32; zero-inflated log-normal illustrative counts; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: Useful but imperfect ranking
cases.description: A seeded synthetic score combines log-count information with noise. It is not an empirical entomological result.
cases.generator: Mulberry32; zero-inflated log-normal illustrative counts; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: Random ranking
cases.description: A seeded random score is independent of the simulated counts. Its realized lift may differ from zero; its expectation over random permutations is zero.
cases.generator: Mulberry32; zero-inflated log-normal illustrative counts; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: Reversed ordering
cases.description: The lowest observed counts receive the highest scores. For heterogeneous non-negative outcomes, normalized lift is -1.
cases.generator: Mulberry32; zero-inflated log-normal illustrative counts; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: No discrimination: all scores tied
cases.description: All scores are equal. Expected-within-tie coverage is the random diagonal, giving lift zero when outcomes vary.
cases.generator: Mulberry32; zero-inflated log-normal illustrative counts; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: Coarse priority categories
cases.description: Several habitats share a priority score. The chart averages possible orders inside each tied block.
cases.generator: Mulberry32; zero-inflated log-normal illustrative counts; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: Equal observed outcomes
cases.description: Every site has the same positive count. There is no advantage available from ranking, so normalized lift is undefined.
cases.generator: Constant illustrative outcomes with Mulberry32-generated scores; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: All-zero observations
cases.description: There is no observed outcome total to divide by. Coverage and normalized lift are undefined; this is not a failed model.
cases.generator: Constant illustrative outcomes with Mulberry32-generated scores; no empirical parameter calibration.

cases.title: Crossing curves: budget matters
cases.description: Two deliberately constructed rankings have crossing curves. A stronger full-curve summary need not win at every selection budget.
cases.generator: Fixed hand-constructed illustration, not empirical data. The seed does not change this case.

cases.title: Jigjiga-shaped simulation: 743-habitat distribution
cases.description: New synthetic counts resampled from the full Jigjiga cohort count distribution. Artificial ranking scores, not historical OOF predictions.
cases.generator: Mulberry32 bootstrap with replacement from aggregate observed count frequencies; independent Mulberry32 score stream. Informative scores use log1p(count) plus normal noise with specified standard deviation.
cases.fit_scope: Univariate empirical recorded-count distribution only; score quality is artificially specified, not fitted to a real model.
